title: Multi-Digit Multiplication
description: Class 5 Maths: multiply 2-digit and 3-digit numbers, estimate products, and solve multiplication word problems — with worked examples and free tests.

topics.title: Multiplying 2-Digit & 3-Digit Numbers
topics.concept:
To multiply by a 2-digit number, multiply by the ones, then by the tens (remember the tens give a number ending in 0), and add the two partial products.

Example: 23 × 12 → 23 × 2 = 46, and 23 × 10 = 230; 46 + 230 = 276.

Multiplying by tens gives a number ending in 0.

topics.title: Estimating & Word Problems
topics.concept: Estimate a product by rounding each number first — useful to check your answer is sensible. In word problems, 'each', 'per', 'rows of' and 'times' mean multiply.

examples.problem: A box has 24 pens. How many in 15 boxes?

recap: 'Each / per / rows of / times' mean multiply.
Use the estimate to check your exact answer.
